deadline.value: Funding deadline December 8, 2026 (apply by this date to enter the University funding competition); the final application deadline is later, but too late for most funding.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 100 overall with at least 25 in each section; this course sets its own English level.
toefl_min.quote: TOEFL Internet Score Element Score Listening 25 Writing 25 Reading 25 Speaking 25 Total 100

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic 7.0 overall (Listening 7.0, Writing 7.0, Reading 6.5, Speaking 7.0).
ielts_min.quote: IELTS (Academic) Element Score Listening 7.0 Writing 7.0 Reading 6.5 Speaking 7.0 Total 7.0

supervisor.value: At least one named supervisor and a research statement are required on the application; applications without them are rejected.
supervisor.quote: If an application does not indicate at least one named supervisor AND include a statement of research interest then the application will be rejected.

funding.value: A small number of EPSRC studentships, mostly for Home students and a few outstanding international students.
funding.quote: a small number of EPSRC (DLA) doctoral training studentships. The majority of these will be offered to Home* students, but a small number may be offered to outstanding International* students.

entry_route.value: A good II.i honours degree (or international equivalent) is the stated standard; no master's is stated.
entry_route.quote: Applicants for this course should have achieved a Good II.i Honours Degree.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

notes: One Engineering PhD covers all divisions (mechanical, electrical, civil and others); the Photonic and Electronic Systems CDT is a separate 1+3 course.
